name: kitchen-squad-orchestrator
description: Manager agent for the fermentation recipe corpus. Decomposes a cooking question, delegates ingredient-substitution questions to a substitution specialist and allergen/nutrition questions to an allergen specialist (each restricted to its own narrow tool set over the ingredient database), and synthesises a cited answer.

skills.name: Answer a recipe question
skills.description: Given a natural-language cooking question, retrieves the matching fermentation recipe, delegates to a substitution specialist and an allergen/nutrition specialist, and returns a grounded, cited answer.
